description: Close an execution with a terminal status and a summary of the projects changed during that run.

changedProjects.description: Projects whose state changed during this execution.

executionId.description: Execution record.id from begin_agent_execution when associating this call with an existing execution; not a session or project ID.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp of the execution event being recorded.

summary.description: Concise account of the work or result being recorded.

terminalStatus.description: Final status of the execution being closed.

name: finalize_agent_execution
title: Finalize agent execution
